description: Deterministic release-gate contract for the PetTripFinder Greater Milwaukee market (PTF-MILWAUKEE-PUBLICATION-037). Consumed by scripts/pettripfinder/assemble_netlify_bundle.py. Complete and self-contained: every number below is calibrated to THIS market's committed authority and none of it is inherited from another market's contract. Contains NO credentials and NO remote project identifiers. The committed hotel-policy package is the single identity authority for the verified hotels; this contract deliberately does NOT restate a hard-coded production allow-list.

deployment_authorization.means: A passing contract means this market's assembled package is STRUCTURALLY deployable: its authority files agree, its routes match its reviewed inventory, no held identity leaks, and every publish and technical gate holds. It is not a deployment authorization and it makes no claim that the market's identity universe is resolved -- 51 of this market's 147 confirmed identities are still unresolved, and PTF-MILWAUKEE-PUBLICATION-037 performed no deployment.

provenance.approval_requirement: Every record in the policy package carries an approval block naming the founder who approved it, the ledger it came from, and both the hashes recomputed at application time and the hashes the founder was shown. A record without one is not publishable, and no row reaches this package on the strength of a review status.
provenance.held_note: The founder HELD these two: both publish priced pet-policy information while their pages never state pets_allowed=true, and the founder declined to authorise that inference. They have no authority record, no exclusion row and no seed inventory row, so no surface has to remember to hide them -- they are absent, not suppressed.

identity_census.note: The 147-identity census was built by PTF-MILWAUKEE-MARKET-FACTORY-001 from five independent source families and reconciled over the full market by PTF-HYATT-BEST-WESTERN-PREMIUM-RESOLUTION-028. The census carries no policy annotation this contract relies on: every no-pets record here was adjudicated into the exclusion registry by an explicit founder decision, never read off a census field.

reconciliation.note: verified_no_pets counts ONLY VERIFIED_NO_PETS records this market owns in launch_packages/pettripfinder/hotel_exclusions.json, each carrying a reviewer_id and an exact quote. unresolved is UNKNOWN and never negative evidence: it is the 147 confirmed identities less the 96 terminally disposed, and it includes 12 whose stated price schema 1.2 cannot hold, 7 whose surface carried no publishable term, the 2 the founder held, and 30 the market has not yet observed. A failed capture answers nothing.
reconciliation.counter_note: The acquisition side of this market reports 'active unresolved 16', which answers a different question: identities the market has TOUCHED and not resolved. This contract's 51 counts every identity that is not terminally disposed, touched or not. Both are correct and neither is a restatement of the other.

policy_package.note: The verified hotel identities are DERIVED from this package at assembly time via scripts.pettripfinder.site_data.verified_public_hotels(); they are not restated here. This market's package additionally carries published: true and a publication block naming the work order that flipped it -- publication is a state of the package, not a property of any record, and the records are byte-identical to the ones the founder approved.
policy_package.structured_pricing_note: Twenty of the seventy records price by stay length and carry fee_tiers rather than a single pet_fee: the ladder IS the price and no single amount is asserted for them. Three carry a fee_cap, which is a ceiling and never a price. A renderer that flattened either would publish a number the property never quoted.
policy_package.sha_note: The sha256 of the package in its PUBLISHED state, which is deterministic: publication adds published: true, a note and a publication block dated from the founder's decision rather than from the clock, so the file a rebuild produces is the file this hash covers. While the market is unpublished the committed package hashes differently, on purpose -- the contract describes the published market.

public_surface.held_hotel_exclusion: Every seed hotel this market owns that is absent from the committed package must have NO public route and NO reference on any surface: hotel profiles, the hotels listing page, nearby-lodging cards, the policy-comparison table, the sitemap, canonicals, internal links and /go/ interstitials. This market owns none -- its seed inventory was derived one row per approved record, so a held or refused property has no inventory row to leak -- and the gate is derived, so it starts enforcing the moment that changes.

routes.note: route_mode market_prefixed: this market's hub, corridor and policy-comparison pages live under /pet-friendly-hotels/milwaukee-wi/. Seven of its configured corridors reach their publication minimum and claim a route; the rest claim none.

publish.note: The publish root must contain ONLY the static website plus the two Netlify control files. Build-internal reports the generator emits are read for gating and never ship.

status_note: Verified: with the package published, release_contracts.verify_contract('milwaukee-wi') returned no disagreements. This document is staged outside deploy/netlify/release_contracts/ because verify_all() checks every contract in that directory and this one is calibrated to a state the market has not entered yet. Moving it there is step three of identity-resolution-review-request.json.
